import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from langchain_core.tools import tool

def _fqdn(name):
    name = name.strip().lower()
    return name if name.endswith('.') else name + '.'

def _archive_existing(zone_path):
    # Move any previous version of the zone file into an archive subfolder
    if zone_path.exists():
        archive_dir = zone_path.parent / 'archive'
        archive_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        stamp = datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')
        zone_path.rename(archive_dir / f'{zone_path.name}.{stamp}')

@tool
def write_basic_zone_file(domain: str, ipv4: str, mail_host: str, nameservers: list, ttl: int, zones_dir: str) -> dict:
    origin = _fqdn(domain)
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow()
    serial = now.strftime('%Y%m%d') + '%02d' % (now.hour,)
    primary_ns = _fqdn(nameservers[0])
    hostmaster = 'hostmaster.' + origin
    lines = [f'$ORIGIN {origin}', f'$TTL {ttl}', f'@ IN SOA {primary_ns} {hostmaster} (', f'    {serial} ; serial', '    7200 ; refresh', '    3600 ; retry', '    1209600 ; expire', f'    {ttl} ) ; minimum', '']
    lines += [f'@ IN NS {_fqdn(ns)}' for ns in nameservers]
    lines += ['', f'@ IN A {ipv4}', f'www IN A {ipv4}', f'@ IN MX 10 {_fqdn(mail_host)}', '@ IN TXT "v=spf1 mx -all"', '']
    target_dir = Path(zones_dir)
    target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    zone_path = target_dir / f'db.{domain.strip().lower()}'
    _archive_existing(zone_path)
    zone_path.write_text('\n'.join(lines))
    return {'path': str(zone_path), 'serial': serial, 'record_count': len(lines)}
